description: Page contents: URL to clean Markdown or text — Fetches one public web page and returns its main content as clean GitHub-flavored Markdown or plain text, with title, canonical URL, language, absolute links and content hashes, for agents that feed pages to a model. Deterministic, no model. Does not run JavaScript (client-rendered pages come back sparse), does not follow links, does not consult robots.txt, and drops navigation, footers, sidebars

include_links.description: Keep Markdown links and return a links list (at most 200).

include_tables.description: Convert data tables to GFM tables; false drops them.

max_chars.description: Content is cut to this many characters; truncated says whether it was.

name: page-contents
